complementos.overview_text: This page brings together all UI components of the project. Each section shows a group of components with their props, variants and usage examples. Browse categories to explore buttons, inputs, layouts, displays and overlays.
complementos.tabs_html_content: HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is the standard language for creating web pages.
complementos.tabs_css_content: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) controls colors, fonts, spacing and responsive layout.
complementos.tabs_js_content: JavaScript adds interactivity to web pages through DOM manipulation and events.
complementos.timeline_v3_desc: Full light/dark mode support with CSS variables.
complementos.emptystate_noresults_desc: We couldn't find anything matching your search. Try different terms.
complementos.typography_body1: body1. Base system text — 18px (16px on mobile). Used for paragraphs and general content.
complementos.typography_body2: body2. Secondary text — 15px (14px on mobile). Ideal for descriptions and metadata.
complementos.typography_caption: caption. Helper text — 13px. For notes, figure captions and small labels.
complementos.typography_props_variant: variant — h1 | h2 | h3 | h4 | h5 | h6 | body1 | body2 | caption | code
complementos.typography_props_component: component — override the HTML element (e.g. h3 as span)
complementos.typography_component_demo: h5 rendered as span, centered, accent color
complementos.icons_import_text: All icons are imported from "./icons" or "../components/icons". Each icon accepts size?: number, className?: string, style?: React.CSSProperties.
complementos.modal_body_sm: **sm** sized modal (360px). Ideal for confirmations or alerts.
complementos.modal_body_md: **md** sized modal (500px). Includes footer buttons with danger/success variants.
complementos.modal_body_lg: **lg** sized modal (680px). `closeOnOverlay=false` — only closes with X button or Escape.
complementos.modal_body_xl: **xl** sized modal (900px). Ideal for wide panels, dashboards or extensive content.
complementos.drawer_content_line2: Use the close button, click outside the panel or press Escape.
complementos.box_text: This is a Box — a div with base styles
complementos.card_body: A Card can contain any content.
complementos.accordion_a1: A component that displays expandable content using native details/summary elements.
complementos.accordion_a2: It accepts items: AccordionItem[]. Each item has question: string and answer: string.
complementos.accordion_a3: Yes, it uses native HTML elements that support keyboard navigation and screen readers.

figcaption.button: 💡 Button accepts variant="default | info | success | warning | danger" to change text color, border and hover.
figcaption.tooltip: 💡 Tooltip is CSS-only: uses ::after + attr(data-tooltip). Background and color adapt to theme via --text-h and --bg.
figcaption.input: 💡 Reusable base Input with variant, size, label, error, design. Uses the same semantic variables as Button.
figcaption.autocomplete: 💡 Autocomplete uses <Input> + native <datalist>. No JavaScript for filtering — accessible and mobile-friendly.
figcaption.select: 💡 Custom dropdown Select with variant, size, label, error, disabled. Keyboard: Enter/Esc, arrows. Selected option with checkmark.
figcaption.textarea: 💡 Multiline Textarea with same API as Input. variant, size, label, error, rows.
figcaption.password: 💡 PasswordInput with show/hide toggle. variant, size, label, error.
figcaption.search: 💡 SearchInput with left SVG magnifier and X clear button. onClear for external handling.
figcaption.number: 💡 NumberInput with ▲▼ steppers. Native spinners hidden. min, max, step. Clamp on blur.
figcaption.date: 💡 DateInput uses the browser's native date picker. Decorative calendar icon. min, max.
figcaption.color: 💡 ColorInput swatch + hex display. Click opens native color picker. variant, size.
figcaption.range: 💡 RangeInput custom slider with track+fill+thumb. variant, size, showValue, min, max, step.
figcaption.file: 💡 FileInput drop zone with drag & drop. accept, multiple. Shows name and size. X button to remove.
figcaption.form: 💡 FormField wraps inputs with label, error, helperText, required. FormGroup groups fields with legend. Compatible with React Hook Form (src/content/react-hook-form.md).
figcaption.box: 💡 Box applies --card-bg, border-radius: 16px, border, box-shadow and padding: 20px. Accepts all native <div> props via ComponentPropsWithoutRef<"div">.
figcaption.card: 💡 Card composes Box adding flex-direction: column, gap: 1rem, overflow: hidden and hover elevation effect. Prop: children: ReactNode.
figcaption.image: 💡 Image extends native (Omit, "children">). Additional prop: caption?: string. If provided, renders a
figcaption.meter: 💡 Meter renders a native <meter>. Props: value (number, required), min (default 0), max (default 1). Examples use min=0 max=100.
figcaption.accordion: 💡 Accordion receives items: AccordionItem[]. Each AccordionItem: { question: string; answer: string }. Uses native <details> / <summary>.
figcaption.breadcrumbs: 💡 Breadcrumbs path navigation with <nav> + aria-label="breadcrumb". Last item has aria-current="page". Customizable separator (default "/").
figcaption.pagination: 💡 Pagination page navigation with automatic ellipsis and aria-current="page".
figcaption.divider: 💡 Divider horizontal (<hr>) or vertical (<span>). orientation (horizontal/vertical), size, variant, label (centered text in horizontal mode).
figcaption.stepper: 💡 Stepper multi-step progress with steps (string[]), activeStep, orientation, alternativeLabel. Numbered circles, checkmark on completed, accent on active.
figcaption.table: 💡 Table tabular data with columns and data. variant (colors header), size, striped, stickyHeader. Auto horizontal scroll.
figcaption.aspectratio: 💡 AspectRatio maintains aspect ratio with padding-bottom technique. ratio (default 16/9), maxWidth, children rendered absolute inside.
figcaption.stack: 💡 Stack (generic with direction), HStack (row, gap 0.5rem), VStack (column, gap 1rem). Extend BoxProps, accept gap and layout props.
figcaption.datatable: 💡 DataTable generic table with sorting, filtering, pagination, row selection and column toggle. columns (key, label, sortable, filterable, render, width), data, pageSize, selectable, striped.
figcaption.badge: 💡 Badge indicator with variant and size. Standalone mode or positioned over a parent container.
figcaption.chip: 💡 Chip removable tag with variant, size, disabled. X button to remove.
figcaption.switch: 💡 Switch boolean toggle with variant (default/info/success/warning/danger), size (sm/md/lg), label, disabled. role="switch" and aria-checked.
figcaption.progress: 💡 Progress determinate bar 0-100%. variant, size, label, showValue. Smooth transition on change.
figcaption.skeleton: 💡 Skeleton loading placeholder with shimmer. Variants: text (lines), circle, rect. count prop to repeat.
figcaption.tabs: 💡 Tabs tab navigation with keyboard (left/right arrows, Home/End). Animated indicator.
figcaption.avatar: 💡 Avatar profile photo or initials. src, alt, size (sm/md/lg), variant (circle/rounded/square), color (Variant). Falls back to alt initials when no src.
figcaption.rating: 💡 Rating star rating. value, onChange, count (default 5), size, readOnly, icon (custom). Keyboard: Arrow keys + Enter. ARIA radiogroup.
figcaption.timeline: 💡 Timeline vertical timeline. Items: title, description, time, icon, color (Variant). Connector line + dots.
figcaption.emptystate: 💡 EmptyState placeholder for empty data. icon, title, description, action (ReactNode, e.g. Button). Centered with gap.
figcaption.typography: 💡 Typography complete type system with predefined variants. Each variant defines font-size, weight, line-height, letter-spacing and color. Auto responsive at 1024px. Respects light/dark theme via CSS variables.
figcaption.theme_toggle: 💡 ThemeToggle is a self-contained component (no props). Reads/writes localStorage("theme"), sets data-theme on <html> and dispatches a themechange event on window to sync all site components.
figcaption.logo: 💡 LogoWatermark combines a webp image with gradient text via background-clip: text. Listens to themechange to refresh the gradient. Props: size?: number.
figcaption.tokens_colors: 💡 Swatches use background: var(--name) and render with the actual active theme value (light/dark). Each variable is defined in :root and overridden in [data-theme="dark"]. Components map their variant prop to these semantic variables via CSS classes. The --shadow variable (not shown) is a composite box-shadow that also changes with theme.
figcaption.tokens_typography: 💡 Self-hosted typography with @fontsource/inter. No external dependency on Google Fonts.
figcaption.tokens_sizes: 💡 Sizes are defined by CSS class in each component (e.g. .sm { --thumb-size: 18px }). The useMediaQuery hook enables responsive JS.
figcaption.icons: 💡 SVG icons use stroke="currentColor" (UI) or fill="currentColor" (social). Inherit text color from parent container.
figcaption.modal: 💡 Modal receives isOpen, onClose, size, title, footer, closeOnOverlay. Blocks scroll, closes with Escape and overlay click.
figcaption.alert: 💡 Alert receives variant (info/success/warning/danger), position, duration (ms, 0 = no auto), closable, message and description.
figcaption.loader: 💡 Loader circular spinner with sizes and variants. LoaderBar indeterminate linear bar. Both use the same semantic color variables.
figcaption.loader_overlay: 💡 LoaderOverlay semi-transparent background with backdrop-filter. Blocks scroll and centers the loader.
figcaption.popover: 💡 Popover contextual overlay on click. position: top/bottom/left/right. Closes on Escape or outside click. Rendered with createPortal.
figcaption.drawer: 💡 Drawer sliding side panel with overlay. position (left/right), size, title. Blocks scroll + Escape to close.
figcaption.treeview: 💡 TreeView hierarchical tree with expand/collapse, selection, keyboard navigation (ArrowUp/Down/Right/Left, Home/End). data (TreeNode[]), selectedId, onSelect, defaultExpandedIds. ARIA tree/treeitem.
figcaption.virtualized: 💡 VirtualizedList virtualized rendering (only visible items + overscan). items: T[], itemHeight, renderItem, height, overscan. Lag-free scrolling for 1000+ items.
figcaption.toast: 💡 Toast stackable notification system. Provides ToastProvider + useToast() hook. addToast({ message, variant?, duration?, position? }). Variants: default/info/success/warning/danger. Auto-dismiss. Closes with Escape.
figcaption.treeselect: 💡 TreeSelect combines Select + TreeView: hierarchical dropdown with expand/collapse, leaf selection, keyboard navigation (ArrowRight/Left expand/collapse).
figcaption.splitpane: 💡 SplitPane two-panel layout with resizable divider via pointer events. horizontal/vertical orientation, minSize, maxSize.
figcaption.commandpalette: 💡 CommandPalette ⌘K-style command palette. Modal with search, category grouping, keyboard shortcuts, ArrowDown/Up navigation.
figcaption.sidebar: 💡 Sidebar collapsible side panel that pushes content (no overlay). CSS transform animation. side left/right, customizable width.
